plan.title: Lab 11 quotes clause-walk evidence absent from a passing Windows 0.119.5 run

narratives.Description: Align Lab 11 Task 3 and its explained solution with the retained literal-acceptance stdout that the fixture's Directive 0.119.5 runner actually emits. This independently buildable story is limited to the Task 3 inspect fragment and classification, their Module 11 content contracts, and the existing runtime observer; it does not promote Windows platform proof or recut the capstone.
narratives.Overview:
## Situation

`labs/11-testing-gates-and-evidence.md` Task 3 tells the learner to inspect
`literal.json.literalAcceptance.stdout` and quotes this required evidence:

```text
verify:ac passed (#3284) (0 verified, 1 unverifiable) [rung=derived]
verify:ac clause walk (#3323): 0 verified, 1 unverifiable, 0 failed
  [unverifiable] clause 1 @ (no path): The focused test and numeric-summary CLI pass for an ordinary sample and an empty sample. — no artifact path bound
Literal acceptance-command gate passed (#3284/#3267): 2 command(s) run verbatim
AC-pass bank checkpoint required (finalize-on-green) (#3285)
unbounded budget — dual-stop still applies; bank is optional discipline
```

On the documented Windows PowerShell route with the exact local 0.119.5 package graph, the helper's `literal` stage passed, `literalAcceptance.exitCode` and `forwardCoverage.exitCode` were both `0`, and `finalStatus` was `PASS`. The retained stdout was instead:

```text
verify:ac passed (#3284) [rung=derived]
Literal acceptance-command gate passed (#3284/#3267): 2 command(s) run verbatim
  ✓ npm run test:focused — exit 0 (expected 0)
  ✓ npm run check:behavior — exit 0 (expected 0)
AC-pass bank checkpoint required (finalize-on-green) (#3285)
unbounded budget — dual-stop still applies; bank is optional discipline
[deft ac-pass-banking] banked scope=northstar.testing.summary-average next=finalize_and_deepen had_surplus=true (#3285)
```

It contained no verified/unverifiable counts, clause-walk summary, or `[unverifiable] clause 1` line for the learner to inspect and classify.

The installed graph was verified with `npm ls`: CLI, core, content, and types all resolved to `0.119.5`.

## Learner pain

The lab asks me to inspect and classify evidence that does not exist in my retained artifact. Because the helper and every relevant exit signal are green, the page gives me no way to decide whether my run is valid, whether Windows is unsupported for this step, or whether I should keep debugging a passing gate. This undermines the module's central lesson that retained evidence should make a result independently auditable.

## Proposed fix

Revalidate the Task 3 stdout on the documented platforms using the exact course graph, then do one of the following:

- update the quoted output to the invariant 0.119.5 form actually produced across platforms; or
- teach both observed variants explicitly and state that the count/clause-walk lines may be absent, with acceptance based on `finalStatus: PASS`, both exit codes being `0`, and the two literal command-success lines.

If platform or runtime conditions control the variant, name those conditions and add explicit acceptance criteria so a learner does not treat a missing clause walk as a failed run. Lock the documented variants in the existing course content check so the quote cannot drift again.

## Environment

- Windows / PowerShell 7.6.5
- Node 26.8.1, npm 11.19.0
- `@deftai/directive`, core, content, and types: exact `0.119.5`
- disposable no-remote Lab 11 repository

## Dedupe

- #56 is directly related but distinct. It reported that a macOS 0.119.5 run *did* print the count and clause-walk lines without explanation; PR #57 added the current quote. This report shows that the resulting required quote is absent from a passing Windows run.
- #54 concerns unpublished `quality-record.json` tokens, not Task 3 stdout.
- #59 concerns missing tool-version prechecks, not retained literal evidence.

No Directive source or framework internals were consulted.
narratives.UserStory: As a Lab 11 learner, I want the Task 3 evidence quote and classification to match the retained Directive 0.119.5 stdout, so that I can audit a passing run without searching for clause-walk evidence the fixture never emits.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Replace the Task 3 and matching solution fences with the retained 0.119.5 fragment: the simple derived-pass lead, literal command gate, two successful command lines, AC-pass-bank notes, and banked line. 2. Recut the nearby classification onto those observed lines and remove the teach-both-variants and platform-controlled-variant framing. 3. Narrow the Module 11 verifier and negative tests to lock the observed fragment and reject the obsolete walk/no-path phrases only inside the Task 3 and matching solution inspect surfaces. 4. Extend the existing full-lab runtime observation to prove the retained stdout and authored content stay aligned.
narratives.Acceptance: 1. Given the Lab 11 Task 3 page and its explained solution, when a learner compares either quote with a passing 0.119.5 fixture artifact, then both show the retained simple pass lead, literal gate, two successful npm command lines, AC-pass-bank notes, and banked line. 2. Given the Task 3 classification, when the learner classifies the retained evidence, then the two stored commands are identified as literal-acceptance proof while the derived rung and bank lines are identified as upstream diagnostics. 3. Given a mutation that removes a retained token or restores clause-walk/no-artifact-path text in the targeted Task 3 or solution inspect fragment, when the Module 11 verifier tests run, then they fail without imposing a course-wide vocabulary ban. 4. Given the existing full Lab 11 fixture observation, when its 0.119.5 literal stage passes, then the retained stdout carries the same locked tokens and the final lab result remains PASS.

The recut binds as one quote of the helper-retained `literal.json.literalAcceptance.stdout` this fixture's 0.119.5 runner already emits. It cannot bind as a Windows/macOS dual quote, and it cannot keep the #56 walk-phrase locks or unverifiable classification as required inspect evidence.

Finding census: **0 `blocks-the-design`**, **2 `sharpens-framing`**, **2 `footnote`**.

## Re-verification of the triage anchors

Stop 1 P1 holds as a page description. At `a484f30613f16d1da3c8f7a01edb5d67e562a12e`:

- `labs/11-testing-gates-and-evidence.md` Task 3 (lines 121-131) quotes clause-walk counts and `[unverifiable] clause 1` as the inspect fragment.
- `scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` (lines 240-247) locks `0 verified, 1 unverifiable` and `no artifact path bound` on that page. `node scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` exits 0 (29 artifacts).

The helper-authored story stamps `plan.acceptance` as `{ commands: ["npm run test:focused", "npm run check:behavior"], none_stated: false, source_rung: "derived" }` with no `clauses` array (`gates-lab.mjs` `story()`). `verifyActiveStory` freezes that object's digest.

Published `@deftai/directive-core@0.119.5` `applyClauseWalk` returns the pre-walk result when `acceptance.clauses` is empty. `relabelVerifyAcPassLead` keeps the simple pass lead when `clauseOutcomes` is empty. `literal-acceptance/run.js` always adds the two `✓` command lines on pass. `maybeAttachAcPassBank` appends the AC-pass-bank notes after a `verified-pass` (successful runs classify as that).

Throwaway helper run this session, Node v24.20.0, exact CLI/core/content/types `0.119.5`, macOS, `finalStatus: PASS`, `literalAcceptance.exitCode: 0`, live `plan.acceptance` still `{commands, none_stated, source_rung}`:

```text
verify:ac passed (#3284) [rung=derived]
Literal acceptance-command gate passed (#3284/#3267): 2 command(s) run verbatim
  ✓ npm run test:focused — exit 0 (expected 0)
  ✓ npm run check:behavior — exit 0 (expected 0)
AC-pass bank checkpoint required (finalize-on-green) (#3285)
unbounded budget — dual-stop still applies; bank is optional discipline
[deft ac-pass-banking] banked scope=northstar.testing.summary-average next=finalize_and_deepen had_surplus=true (#3285)
```

That string is the issue's Windows paste. A prior complete helper attempt on this host (2026-09-21) retained the same stdout.

Calling `walkAcceptanceClauses` on a hand-built clause 1 with `artifact_path: null` produces the Task 3 walk lines (`0 verified, 1 unverifiable` / `[unverifiable] clause 1 @ (no path): … — no artifact path bound`). The helper never puts that clause array on the active brief, so `verify:ac` never prepends those lines.

## Findings

### 1. Quote the retained helper stdout as the single 0.119.5 inspect fragment

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: the live helper stdout above; empty `plan.acceptance.clauses` on the live brief; `applyClauseWalk` early-return; the issue paste matching this macOS capture byte-for-byte on the pass lead, the two `✓` lines, the two checkpoint lines, and the banked line. The current Task 3 fence also omits those `✓` lines, which the 0.119.5 pass path always emits, so no engine path emits the current fence verbatim.

Failure mode: a dual-variant recut would teach a Windows form and a macOS form for one runner output. A learner on either documented path would still fail to find the walk lines the page calls required inspect evidence. An implementer who kept the current fence as "the macOS form" would ship the #56 miss again.

Disposition: after the revalidation the body already asks for, bind option 1 as the whole recut: replace the Task 3 fence (and the matching explained-solution fence) with the retained stdout. Drop the "teach both observed variants" arm and the "if platform or runtime conditions control the variant" arm for this fixture. Recut the Task 3 classification bullets onto lines that stdout actually carries: the two stored npm commands as the literal-acceptance proof; `[rung=derived]` and the AC-pass-bank dual-stop lines as upstream 0.119.5 diagnostics.

Road-not-taken: hand-stamp `plan.acceptance.clauses` on the helper story so `applyClauseWalk` would emit the #56 walk lines. That is a new fixture contract. This lab never runs `scope:activate` / `scope:promote` (the 0.119.5 stamper that fills clauses while commands exist). O11.6 already asks for passing `verify:ac` results in `literal.json`. Flip that verdict if the lab starts teaching #3323 activate as a required step whose purpose is the walk vocabulary.

### 2. Recut the Module 11 fragment locks onto the retained stdout

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` lines 240-247 require the lab page to include `0 verified, 1 unverifiable` and `no artifact path bound`. Lines 256-260 require the explained solution to include Lab 11 clause 1 text and `no artifact path bound`. `scripts/gates-lab.test.mjs` "full lab retains ordered red-green-refactor and aggregate diagnosis evidence" already runs this helper through `literal` on the `labs-7-10-11-platform-validation` matrix (`macos-node24`, `linux-node24`, `windows-node24`) and asserts `finalStatus: PASS` only. It never reads `literal.json.literalAcceptance.stdout`.

Failure mode: replacing the fenced quote while leaving those locks in place either fails `check:module-11` or keeps forcing the page to name walk phrases the runner does not retain. A page-only include check is also how the current fence shipped: it locks whatever phrases the markdown contains, with no observer of retained stdout.

Disposition: recut the existing Module 11 content check so the lab page (and the explained solution) lock tokens from the retained fragment: `verify:ac passed (#3284) [rung=derived]`, `Literal acceptance-command gate passed (#3284/#3267): 2 command(s) run verbatim`, and the two `✓` command lines. Drop the walk-phrase and `no artifact path bound` fragment locks on Lab 11. The existing full-lab test is the in-repo observer of retained stdout; asserting those same tokens there is what makes "the quote cannot drift again" true against the runner.

### 3. Capstone currently locks the same walk phrases on the same acceptance shape

class: footnote

`labs/fixtures/capstone-end-to-end/capstone-lab.mjs` stamps the same `commands` / `none_stated: false` / `source_rung: "derived"` acceptance with no `clauses`. `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` lines 549-557 lock `0 verified, 1 unverifiable` and `no artifact path bound` on the capstone lab page. That is the same inspect identity on another surface. This envelope's target is Lab 11 Task 3.

### 4. Inspect-identity recut leaves the Windows platform-proof at candidate

class: footnote

`references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md` still records `teaching-platform-proof:windows-pwsh7 status=candidate`. `scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` already refuses promoting that row to `verified`. Lab 11 still names Windows/PowerShell as a candidate. Quoting the retained stdout does not by itself complete a native Windows 0.119.5 platform proof.
